title: Proxy Pattern
overview: Provide a surrogate or placeholder for another object to control access to it.
useCases: You want to control or manage access to an object
The class you want to add behaviour around cannot or should not be changed
Adding cross-cutting concerns like lazy loading, access control, logging, or caching around an existing object
exampleUses: A virtual proxy that loads a large image from disk only when it is actually drawn on screen
A protection proxy that checks the caller's role before allowing access to a sensitive financial service
A caching proxy that stores results of expensive API calls and returns cached responses for repeated requests
